_metadata.description: The Today meal-first hero, seven-day strip, full-day overview, occurrence actions, and scoped swaps with preview, undo, and immutable history.

requirements.title: Today leads with the next relevant meal and one dominant action
requirements.description: When a user opens Today, the scenario shall show a hero for the next relevant noncompleted occurrence by configured slots and local date, with a date and slot eyebrow, meal title, short description, active and total time, Start cooking as the dominant action, Swap meal, a quiet details menu, a seven-day strip below, and Ready for tonight links to Check ingredients and Open grocery list; another selected date shall be labeled explicitly rather than as Tonight, and an empty account shall see Choose a meal or Plan my week instead of demo food.

validation.notes: Planned: the hero picks the next noncompleted occurrence per configured slots and labels a non-today selection by its date and slot, never Tonight (AT-006).
Planned: a fresh account shows Choose a meal or Plan my week and no demo bowl; a meal with only an ordinary photo or none keeps the same actions (AT-001, AT-004, AT-005, ACT-022).

requirements.title: Swap alternatives are reason-chipped and scoped
requirements.description: When the user opens What sounds better?, the scenario shall show up to four useful alternatives with optional reason chips Something different, Less effort, Lower cost, and Missing ingredients, and a missing-ingredient exclusion shall belong to that swap only and never become a permanent dislike or allergy.

validation.notes: Planned: a reason reranks or filters candidates, no reason is mandatory, and only alternatives that pass active hard constraints are selectable (ACT-018).

requirements.title: Swap previews scoped effects before apply
requirements.description: A swap shall preview the updated day and week nutrients, portion and checkout costs, required groceries, and batch dependencies for the selected future occurrence and planned servings, leaving other occurrences unchanged unless the user explicitly replaces matching future occurrences with a count and preview.

validation.notes: Planned: applying a single-slot swap affects only that occurrence, recomputes derived plan state, and offers a compact confirmation when a required target, batch, or lock is affected (ACT-018).

Planned: swapping one future meal changes only that occurrence and refreshes groceries and assessments; a swap that conflicts with a locked leftover dependency shows an impact preview or repair (AT-007, AT-008).

requirements.title: History is never edited and undo respects revisions
requirements.description: When a swap undoes, the scenario shall restore the prior occurrence and derived plan state only if the affected revisions still match, otherwise offer a fresh preview, and consumed occurrences and recorded history shall never be changed by a swap.

validation.notes: Planned: a consumed occurrence is not offered for replacement, and a conflicting newer edit produces a new preview instead of being overwritten (ACT-018).

requirements.title: The Today overview keeps full-day scope explicit
requirements.description: Below the hero, the scenario shall show a collapsible Today overview listing every configured slot, recurring item, and supplement occurrence, with nutrition summaries labeled Planned, Recorded, or Expected, so a single meal's values never appear as the whole day's and missing targets never become default personalized numbers.

validation.notes: Planned: Expected combines recorded intake with explicitly remaining planned quantities without double-counting a partially eaten occurrence (AT-013, ACT-041).
Planned: a dinner-only plan reports the rest of the day as not covered rather than as a failed or passed daily target (FIX-04).

requirements.title: Occurrence actions match status and never delete history
requirements.description: The Today occurrence shall offer Start cooking for a cookable revision, View meal or Log meal for a ready-to-eat item, and Edit for a draft missing instructions, plus View recipe, Move, Lock or unlock, Change servings, Skip, Remove from plan, and Record intake as status and permissions allow, where removing a future occurrence never deletes the recipe or erases intake history.

validation.notes: Planned: a draft without steps opens an incomplete detail view with Edit instead of an empty cooking session, and Remove from plan leaves the recipe and recorded intake intact (R08.2, AT-017).
